symptoms.label: Canceled requests leave funds unavailable
symptoms.root_cause: Customers see money held or deducted after canceled, unmatched, or interrupted requests, and refunds may be partial or credited to the wrong place. The fix is to release the full unused amount reliably and show its destination and posting status.

symptoms.label: Ride payment records conflict
symptoms.root_cause: Customers see duplicate debits, unexpected fare amounts, or balances that disagree with how they paid or whether they took the ride. The fix is to reconcile authorizations, final fares, cash or Pix payments, and ride records before charging or collecting a balance.

dropped_causes.label: Canceled ride auto-closes without reversal
dropped_causes.description: The app or dispatch system closes a request automatically after a matching or connection issue without triggering the payment reversal.
